name: adobe-photoshop
description: Inspect and edit Adobe Photoshop documents through a Windows COM MCP server and guarded workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and edit Photoshop through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Inspect the Photoshop session, active document and selection; create or open documents; add text and filled layers; and save verified PSD, PNG, or JPEG copies with overwrite guardrails.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Photoshop session without changing it.
Add a text layer and verify the document afterward.
Save a verified copy without overwriting files.
